Bahrain's Interior Ministry says an Iranian attack hit a civilian industrial facility and started a fire. Iran's Revolutionary Guards claim they targeted US bases.

Ukrainian long-range drones will be built in Britain, Ukraine's Defense Ministry says. Defense ministers Yevhenii Khmara and Wes Streeting signed deals on joint production of middle strike and deep strike drones, which Britain will fund and then hand over to Ukrainian troops.
